  • Post number 1: notes from the dock

    Jan 2, 2026

    The harbor town woke slowly, as it always did when the fog refused to lift before nine. When the first shipment arrived, nobody cheered, but several people stayed late to unpack it.

  • Post number 5: notes from the dock

    Jan 6, 2026

    The report concluded that patience, not funding, had been the scarce resource all along. A small cooperative formed, fragile at first, then stubborn, then quietly indispensable.
